name: Duck pho
summary: Phở vịt is the hot bowl beside phở chua: soft noodles and firm, fragrant roast duck in a rich broth that smells of spice.
origin: Cao Bang city, in the morning.
howToEat: Order it at breakfast in town when you want the warmer of the two pho.
